#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Random FIB/trace generator for cross-check tests."""
import random, sys

def rand_addr(rng, upper=None):
    if upper is None:
        upper = rng.getrandbits(64)
    lower = rng.getrandbits(64)
    return upper, lower

def fmt(upper, lower, rng):
    groups = []
    u, l = upper, lower
    words = [(upper >> 48) & 0xffff, (upper >> 32) & 0xffff, (upper >> 16) & 0xffff, upper & 0xffff,
             (l >> 48) & 0xffff, (l >> 32) & 0xffff, (l >> 16) & 0xffff, l & 0xffff]
    style = rng.randrange(4)
    if style == 0:
        return ":".join("%x" % w for w in words)
    if style == 1:
        return ":".join("%X" % w for w in words)
    if style == 2:
        # compressed form: find a run of zeros
        s = ":".join("%x" % w for w in words)
        best = None
        i = 0
        while i < 8:
            if words[i] == 0:
                j = i
                while j < 8 and words[j] == 0: j += 1
                if best is None or (j - i) > (best[1] - best[0]): best = (i, j)
                i = j
            else:
                i += 1
        if best and best[1] - best[0] >= 1:
            i, j = best
            left = ":".join("%x" % w for w in words[:i])
            right = ":".join("%x" % w for w in words[j:])
            return left + ("::" if i > 0 else ":") + (right if right else "")
        return s
    # style 3: ipv4-embedded tail when possible
    if words[4] == 0 and words[5] == 0 and words[6] in (0, 0xffff):
        head = ":".join("%x" % w for w in words[:6])
        v4 = "%d.%d.%d.%d" % (words[6] >> 8, words[6] & 0xff, words[7] >> 8, words[7] & 0xff)
        if words[5] == 0xffff:
            return "::ffff:" + v4
        return head + "::" + v4
    return ":".join("%x" % w for w in words)

def gen_fib(path, n, rng, allow_dup=False, max_len=64):
    seen = set()
    lines = []
    for _ in range(n):
        ln = rng.choice([0, 1, rng.randrange(0, 65), rng.randrange(0, 65),
                         rng.randrange(48, 65), rng.randrange(0, 17), 64, 63, 32])
        ln = min(64, max(0, ln))
        while True:
            upper, lower = rand_addr(rng)
            if ln > 0:
                upper &= (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln)) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
            key = (upper, ln)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            break
        hop = rng.choice([0, 1, 4294967295, rng.randrange(0, 2**32), rng.randrange(0, 256)])
        lines.append("%s/%d %d" % (fmt(upper, lower, rng), ln, hop))
    open(path, 'w').write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

def gen_trace(path, fib_prefixes, n, rng):
    """fib_prefixes: list of (start,len) to derive interesting queries."""
    lines = []
    for _ in range(n):
        if fib_prefixes and rng.random() < 0.7:
            s, ln = rng.choice(fib_prefixes)
            base = s
            # pick a key inside [s, s+2^(64-ln))
            off = rng.getrandbits(64 - ln) if ln < 64 else 0
            upper = (s + off) & ((1 << 64) - 1)
        else:
            upper = rng.getrandbits(64)
        lower = rng.getrandbits(64)
        lines.append(fmt(upper, lower, rng))
    open(path, 'w').write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    seed = int(sys.argv[1]); nfib = int(sys.argv[2]); ntrace = int(sys.argv[3])
    fibp, tracep = sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5]
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    gen_fib(fibp, nfib, rng)
    import re
    fx = []
    for line in open(fibp):
        if not line.strip(): continue
        spec, hop = line.split()
        addr, ln = spec.rsplit('/', 1)
        ln = int(ln)
        b = bytes(16)
        import socket, struct
        b = socket.inet_pton(socket.AF_INET6, addr)
        upper = struct.unpack(">Q", b[:8])[0]
        start = 0 if ln == 0 else upper & (((1 << ln) - 1) << (64 - ln))
        fx.append((start, ln))
    gen_trace(tracep, fx, ntrace, rng)
PYEOF
cat > /work/tmp/cross.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Cross-check build+lookup against the brute-force reference.
set -u
T=/work/tmp
fails=0
for seed in $(seq 1 40); do
  for nfib in 0 1 2 3 5 17 60 200; do
    ntrace=$(( (seed % 5) * 7 + 3 ))
    python3 $T/gen.py $seed $nfib $ntrace $T/f.txt $T/tr.txt || { echo "GEN FAIL"; exit 1; }
    /work/submit/planb64 build $T/f.txt $T/i.idx 2>$T/err.txt || { echo "BUILD FAIL seed=$seed n=$nfib"; cat $T/err.txt; fails=1; continue; }
    python3 $T/ref.py build $T/f.txt > $T/r.idx || { echo "REF FAIL"; exit 1; }
    if ! cmp -s $T/i.idx $T/r.idx; then echo "IDX DIFF seed=$seed n=$nfib"; diff $T/i.idx $T/r.idx | head -5; fails=1; fi
    for m in scalar "batch 1" "batch 7" "batch 256" "batch 03"; do
      /work/submit/planb64 lookup $T/i.idx $T/tr.txt $m > $T/o.txt 2>$T/err.txt || { echo "LOOKUP FAIL $m"; cat $T/err.txt; fails=1; continue; }
      python3 $T/ref.py lookup $T/f.txt $T/tr.txt > $T/ro.txt || { echo "REF LOOKUP FAIL"; exit 1; }
      if ! cmp -s $T/o.txt $T/ro.txt; then echo "OUT DIFF seed=$seed n=$nfib mode=$m"; diff $T/o.txt $T/ro.txt | head -5; fails=1; fi
    done
  done
done
[ $fails -eq 0 ] && echo "CROSS-CHECK OK" || echo "CROSS-CHECK FAILURES"
EOF
